flagship.title: Occoneechee Mountain and the quarry overlook
flagship.standfirst: A 2.2-mile loop that climbs about 350 feet above the Eno to a rocky overlook at the old quarry, then drops back to the river.
flagship.why_this_week: The short-and-close choice: twenty minutes out, done well before lunch, with a real climb and a view at the top. The outlook for the weekend has no clear signal either way, so this is the plan that survives a changing forecast. If Saturday looks wet on Friday night, go on Sunday instead.
flagship.headline_condition: Outlook only: mild, no clear rain signal

route.surface: Roots and rock; short, steep pitches near the quarry

access.name: Occoneechee Mountain State Natural Area, 625 Virginia Cates Rd., Hillsborough
access.parking: Small lot at the end of Virginia Cates Rd. It fills on fair weekends, so arrive near opening.

dog.water: The Eno along the river section of the loop
dog.shade: Wooded, except the open rock at the overlook
watch_for: Loose, crumbling rock at the quarry edge: keep him back from the drop

photo.alt: Block-print plate: Rupert in his mustard collar sits on a hatched rock ledge above a blue river, wooded ridges behind and a low ochre sun.

local_trail.title: Brumley Forest
local_trail.line: Woods and field edges ten minutes north of town, for the morning that gets away from you.

away_mission.title: Hanging Rock, Moore's Wall Loop
away_mission.line: The full-day version: 4.2 strenuous miles to the tower on Moore's Knob. Worth it only if both days look dry.

wildcard.title: Hillsborough Riverwalk, after the mountain
wildcard.line: Five minutes from the trailhead: a flat, easy stretch along the Eno to cool down, then coffee in town.

mission.text: Reach the overlook, then the river, and see which one Rupert chooses to sit at.

memory_prompt.text: Rupert at the overlook, with the valley behind him.

conditions.summary: Outlook only, well ahead of the weekend: no clear rain signal, and mid-October highs are typically in the low to mid 70s. This will be replaced by the forecast on publication day.

pivot.if: Rain or thunder on Saturday morning
pivot.note: Brumley is ten minutes away. Save the overlook for a clear day, when the rock is dry.

practical.closures_note: Check the park's alerts page before leaving.
